notes:
## 中文

- **新版本入口** 换上小巧的 New 标识，保留文字动效；整个按钮背景均可点击，移除多余的焦点外环。
- **下载进度** 已知安装包大小时从 0% 显示实际下载进度，减少不确定进度动画造成的困惑。
- **更新弹窗** 修复更新完成后按钮默认聚焦的问题，保留回车确认及键盘导航。
- **正文留白** 微调原文与译文的内部间距，让文字与边缘保持更舒适的距离。

## English

- **Update entry** A compact New mark accompanies the existing text animation. The full button background is clickable, with the extra focus outline removed.
- **Download progress** Once the installer size is known, downloads show actual progress starting at 0% instead of an indeterminate animation.
- **Update dialogs** Fixed the confirmation button receiving focus by default after an update, while preserving Return confirmation and keyboard navigation.
- **Text spacing** Refined the inner padding of the source and translation panes for more comfortable spacing around text.

## 中文

- **原文与译文朗读** 两侧新增小喇叭，使用 macOS 系统声音；点击朗读，再次点击立即停止，下次从头播放。默认不自动朗读，同一时间只播放一侧。
- **英美口音切换** 英语口音直接显示，支持美式与英式切换并记住选择；朗读时显示声波动效，切换口音或修改文字会停止当前播放。
- **更紧凑的内容区** 缩小两侧内容内边距，对齐语言选择、文字和操作按钮。
- **更安静的更新体验** 启动时检查更新失败不会打断使用；手动检查失败时会给出提示。

## English

- **Read either text aloud** Speaker buttons use macOS system voices for the source and translation. Click to read, click again to stop, and start again from the beginning. Playback never starts automatically, and only one side plays at a time.
- **US and UK accents** English accent choices are visible and remembered. Animated sound waves indicate playback; changing the accent or editing text stops it.
- **More compact content panes** Reduced inner padding aligns language selectors, text and actions.
- **Quieter update checks** Failed update checks at startup do not interrupt your work. Manual checks still show feedback if they fail.

## 中文

- **窗口按钮悬停修复** 鼠标移入主窗口或设置窗口左上角的三个按钮时，正常显示关闭、最小化和全屏图标；移开后隐藏，保留原有按钮位置与主窗口紧凑间距。

## English

- **Window button hover fix** The close, minimize, and full-screen symbols now appear when hovering over the three window buttons in the main and Settings windows, and disappear when the pointer leaves. Button positions and the compact main-window spacing are preserved.

## 中文

- **编辑后返回截图悬浮窗** 在主窗口修改截图译文后，可从右上角返回原来的截图与工具条，保留编辑内容、语言和窗口位置，无需重新识别或翻译；多次往返仍可恢复截图前的内容。
- **更整齐的主窗口** 将「恢复上一条」与「返回悬浮窗」集中在右上角，统一按钮样式；对齐双栏语言选择框与内容边缘，为复制按钮增加边框。
- **精细调整截图工具条** 更新图标与语言箭头，改善悬停留白和按钮间距，移除分隔竖线；更多菜单使用紧凑的图标列表，保留原有配色与圆角。
- **统一滚动体验** 截图编辑区沿用全局覆盖式滚动条，保持现有宽度；微调完整译文浮层的关闭按钮与滚动条位置，保留正文排版。

## English

- **Return to the screenshot overlay after editing** Use the upper-right action to return from the main window with your edited translation, language choices, and overlay position intact. No new OCR or translation is needed, and repeated round trips preserve the content from before the screenshot.
- **Better-aligned main window** Restore previous and Back to floating window now share matching buttons at the upper right. Language selectors align with the pane content, and copy buttons have clear borders.
- **Refined screenshot toolbar** Updated icons and language arrows, balanced hover insets and button spacing, and removed vertical separators. More uses a compact icon list while keeping the existing colors and corner shapes.
- **Consistent scrolling** Screenshot editing uses the shared overlay scrollbar style at its existing width. The full-translation popover has better-positioned close and scroll controls without changing its text layout.

## 中文

- **更合适的更新窗口** 小更新按内容调整高度，较多内容可滚动查看；下载、验证和检查结果使用统一的紧凑弹窗，保留原有标题与图标样式。
- **更清晰的错误提示** 长错误信息自动换行并可滚动，重试按钮尺寸保持一致；正文与操作区间距更加协调。
- **更自然的键盘操作** 弹窗打开时不自动聚焦操作按钮；支持 Tab 切换、回车确认、空格激活已选按钮和 Esc 关闭可取消的状态，进度刷新不抢走已选择的焦点。

## English

- **Better-sized update dialogs** Small updates fit their content, while longer notes scroll. Download, verification, and check results use consistent compact dialogs with the existing titles and icons.
- **Clearer error messages** Long errors wrap and scroll, retry buttons keep a consistent size, and content has balanced spacing above the actions.
- **More natural keyboard control** Opening a dialog no longer focuses an action automatically. Use Tab to navigate, Return to confirm, Space to activate the focused button, and Esc to close cancellable states. Progress updates preserve your chosen focus.

## 中文

- **更清晰的截图边界** 截图采用固定柔晴蓝细边框和轻微圆角，在不同主题与材质下保持一致；图片内容、工具条样式和间距保持原样。
- **拖动图片与工具条** 按住截图即可整体移动图片与工具条，原图和译图均可拖动；切换对照或刷新译图后保留位置，复制与保存仍输出完整图片。

## English

- **Clearer screenshot edges** A fixed soft-blue border and subtle rounded corners stay consistent across themes and materials, preserving image content, toolbar styling, and spacing.
- **Move the image and toolbar together** Drag either the original or translated image to reposition the entire overlay. Comparing images or refreshing the translation preserves its position; copying and saving still use the complete image.

## 中文

- **更轻盈的截图浮层** 减轻图片与单行工具条的阴影，细化边框，适配浅色和深色外观；现有布局与功能保持不变。
- **更新日期提示修复** 打开更新弹窗及切换下载、验证、安装阶段时，不再自动显示并滞留精确日期提示；悬停查看完整日期仍然可用。

## English

- **Lighter screenshot overlays** Softer, separate shadows and finer borders for the image and single-row toolbar in light and dark appearances, preserving the existing layout and controls.
- **Update date tooltip fix** Opening update dialogs or moving between download, verification, and installation no longer opens a persistent date tooltip automatically. Hovering still shows the full publication date.

## 中文

- **更紧凑的截图工具条** 服务独立分组，原文与译文语言共用边框；单行图标按钮提供功能提示，语言悬停背景与边框之间保留留白。
- **更顺手的截图操作** 重新翻译、原图对照、全文查看、复制和保存集中在工具条；更多菜单提供其他复制方式和主窗口编辑。重新框选后可确认翻译或取消。
- **按区域编辑与恢复** 在主窗口点击图片文字区域即可定位对应译文；支持单段重译及恢复该段生成译文，保留其他区域的手动修改。
- **保留熟悉的主窗口** 沿用原有头部、图标与自动互译特效，统一截图编辑区间距，支持左右和上下布局。关闭菜单或取消保存时保留截图结果。

## English

- **Compact screenshot toolbar** The service has its own group, while source and target languages share a border. Single-row icon buttons include tooltips, with inset hover backgrounds for language choices.
- **Quicker screenshot actions** Retranslate, compare the original, read the full translation, copy, and save from the toolbar. More offers additional copy options and editing in the main window. Confirm or cancel after selecting a new region.
- **Edit and restore individual regions** Click text regions in the image to locate their translations. Retranslate one region or restore its generated translation while keeping edits to other regions.
- **The familiar main window** Keep the existing header, icons, and automatic-translation effects, with consistent editor spacing and side-by-side or stacked layouts. Dismissing a menu or cancelling Save keeps the screenshot open.

## 中文

- 检查更新使用独立的紧凑弹窗，仅显示状态、进度和取消操作。
- 检查失败时，重试和关闭按钮保持相同尺寸；已是最新版时提供简洁提示。
- 检查完成后切换到原有更新说明，两个弹窗不叠加，更新说明的样式与布局保持不变。

## English

- Update checks use a separate compact dialog with status, progress, and a Cancel button.
- Failed checks show equally sized Retry and Close buttons; up-to-date checks show a concise confirmation.
- Completed checks switch to the existing release notes without overlapping dialogs. The release-notes styling and layout remain unchanged.

## 中文

- **统一翻译主窗口** 输入与快捷取词共用主窗口，左上角显示来源；新内容替换当前内容后可恢复上一条，Esc 收起并返回来源应用。
- **原位截图翻译** 框选后在所选区域附近显示完整图片与译文，支持自动或手动翻译、语言切换、原图对照、全文查看、复制文字或图片，以及保存原图和译图。需要继续编辑时可送入主窗口。
- **更清楚的权限引导** 辅助功能与屏幕录制提示采用系统标题栏和左上角窗口按钮，简要说明用途、数据去向与设置入口。
- **易读的用量记录** 日期显示完整年月日，时间单独成行；费用保留两位小数，不足一美分的非零费用显示为 <$0.01，仍可查看精确值。
- **更新弹窗修复** 限制更新内容弹窗的最大高度，增加上下留距，并修复设置窗口蒙层边缘漏白。

### 升级前须知

更新会重启 TSX，请先复制需要保留的文字或保存截图。复杂照片纹理、重叠区域或过长译文可能无法直接覆盖排版；这些区域保留原图，并提供完整译文查看。

## English

- **One main translation window** Typed input and shortcut selections share the main window, with the source at the upper left. Restore the previous content after it is replaced, or press Esc to hide the window and return to the source app.
- **Screenshot translation in place** View the complete image and translations near your selected region. Translate automatically or manually, switch languages, compare the original, read the full text, copy text or images, and save original or translated images. Open the result in the main window to continue editing.
- **Clearer permission guidance** Accessibility and Screen Recording prompts use a system title bar and standard window buttons, with concise explanations of their purpose, data handling, and the settings action.
- **Readable usage records** Full calendar dates and times appear on separate lines. Costs use two decimal places; nonzero amounts below one cent show <$0.01, with precise values still available.
- **Update dialog fixes** Release-note dialogs have a maximum height and more vertical spacing. Fixed uncovered edges in the Settings backdrop.

### Before updating

TSX restarts during an update. Copy text or save screenshots you want to keep first. Intricate photo textures, overlapping regions, or long translations may not fit directly over the image; those regions retain the original pixels and offer the full translation.

## 中文

- **关于页一键更新** 点击「更新到 v…」后直接下载并接续安装、重启，进度留在设置窗口，不再切换到主窗口重复确认。「检查更新」仍只检查，不改变自动更新偏好。
- **更舒展的更新弹窗** 「发现新版本」弹窗随主窗口大小调整，在限定的最小与最大尺寸之间缩放；默认主窗口可展示较大尺寸，更新内容更易阅读。
- **界面细节修复** 本机服务的文本接收提示使用易懂的名称，修正提示图标与文字对齐，并为「发现新版本」按钮补上悬停手型光标。

## English

- **One-click updates from About** Clicking Update to v… starts downloading and continues through installation and restart, with progress kept in Settings and no repeated confirmation in the main window. Check for Updates still only checks, without changing automatic-update preferences.
- **More room for release notes** The New Version Available dialog adapts to the main window between defined minimum and maximum sizes. The default main window shows the larger dialog for easier reading.
- **Interface fixes** Local-service text-recipient hints use a readable name, their icons align with the text, and the New Version Available button shows a pointing-hand cursor on hover.

## 中文

- **更多 API 厂商预设** 新增 Kimi、GLM、Qwen、Gemini、Xiaomi MiMo、MiniMax、Doubao、StepFun、xAI、Mistral、SiliconFlow 和 OpenRouter，使用自己的 API Key 配置翻译服务。
- **自定义服务与图标** 新增 New API 和自定义连接，支持兼容的 Chat Completions、Responses 与 Claude Messages 接口，以及完整请求地址和独立模型列表地址；添加和编辑时可切换服务商及品牌或通用图标。
- **更一致的服务设置** 移除手填模型入口，新选择从获取的模型列表中完成；已有服务保留已保存模型。统一必填标记、输出上限下拉框、按钮与滚动条，修复服务商和图标需要重复点击才能更换的问题。
- **更紧凑的权限与更新提示** 重排权限浮窗并统一窗口按钮尺寸；三个更新内容弹窗采用紧凑布局，显示发布时间与精确时间提示，省去常规安装说明。
- **交互细节修复** 修复切换翻译服务后「正在使用」提示持续显示的问题，调整用量统计日期选择卡片的间距。

## English

- **More API provider presets** Added Kimi, GLM, Qwen, Gemini, Xiaomi MiMo, MiniMax, Doubao, StepFun, xAI, Mistral, SiliconFlow, and OpenRouter. Configure translation with your own API key.
- **Custom services and icons** Added New API and custom connections for compatible Chat Completions, Responses, and Claude Messages endpoints, including full request URLs and separate model-list URLs. Change providers and choose brand or generic icons while adding or editing a service.
- **Consistent service settings** Removed manual model entry: new selections come from fetched model lists, while existing services retain saved models. Unified required-field markers, output-limit menus, buttons, and scrollbars, and fixed provider and icon choices requiring a second click.
- **Compact permission and update dialogs** Refined permission panels and matched window-control sizes. All three release-note dialogs use a compact layout with publication dates and precise-time tooltips, without routine installation instructions.
- **Interaction fixes** Fixed the persistent In use tooltip after switching translation services and improved spacing in usage date-range cards.

## 中文

- 更新确认弹窗现在显示在翻译主窗口中央，优化标题、版本对比、内容间距与下载图标，采用蓝色「立即更新」按钮。
- 主窗口右上角新增「发现新版本」入口，图标与文字依次轻跳；悬停、窗口失焦、弹窗打开或启用减少动态效果时暂停，文字完整显示。
- 修复打开设置后翻译窗口重新抢占焦点的问题。更新时先处理未保存的服务设置，关闭更新弹窗后保留翻译内容。
- 开发构建停用在线更新，避免正式发行包覆盖 Xcode 构建产物；正式版更新功能保持可用。

### 安装与说明

需要 macOS 15 或更新版本；通用安装包包含 Apple silicon 和 Intel 架构。下载 `TSX-1.1.2-macOS-universal.dmg`，打开后拖入 Applications，也可通过「检查更新」升级。安装包使用 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证，校验值见 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。源码采用 MIT 许可证。

更新完成后会重新启动 TSX，请先复制需要保留的文字；翻译正文和截图不保存为历史。自动识别可能误判孤立短词，可手动选择源语言。自动测试与构造界面检查不等于 Intel、macOS 15 真机或真实跨版本升级已完成验收。

## English

- Update dialogs now appear in the main translation window, with a refined title, version comparison, spacing, download icons, and a blue Update now button.
- Added a New version available entry in the upper-right corner. Its icon and letters move in a subtle wave, pausing on hover, while the window is inactive, during a modal, or when Reduce Motion is enabled. The label remains fully visible.
- Fixed the translation window taking focus back after Settings opens. Updates respect unsaved service settings, and dismissing the update dialog preserves translation content.
- Disabled online updates in development builds to prevent a distribution package from overwriting Xcode build products. Release builds retain normal update support.

### Installation and notes

Requires macOS 15 or later. The universal installer includes Apple silicon and Intel binaries. Download `TSX-1.1.2-macOS-universal.dmg` and drag TSX into Applications, or use Check for Updates. The installer is Developer ID signed and Apple notarized; checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Source code is MIT licensed.

TSX restarts after updating. Copy text you want to keep first; translation text and screenshots are not saved as history. Automatic detection may misidentify isolated words; select the source language manually when needed. Automated tests and constructed UI checks do not establish validation on Intel, macOS 15 hardware, or the real upgrade path.

## 中文

- 修复双栏编辑中删除到空白后，另一侧仍残留旧内容的问题；清空后重新输入可继续双向翻译。
- 清空时取消旧翻译，避免延迟返回的结果重新填入；保留中文输入法组合输入的正常行为。
- 缩小主窗口两侧语言选择框和占位提示文字，让文字层级更协调。

### 安装与说明

需要 macOS 15 或更新版本；通用安装包支持 Apple silicon 和 Intel。下载 `TSX-1.1.1-macOS-universal.dmg`，打开后拖入 Applications，也可通过「检查更新」升级。安装包使用 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证，校验值见 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。源码采用 MIT 许可证。

更新前请复制需要保留的文字，翻译正文和截图不保存为历史。自动识别可能误判孤立短词，可手动选择源语言。自动测试不等于 Intel、macOS 15 真机或真实跨版本升级已完成验收。

## English

- Fixed stale text remaining in the opposite pane after either editor is cleared. Typing again resumes bidirectional translation.
- Clearing now cancels previous translations and rejects late results while preserving normal input-method composition.
- Reduced the language-selector and placeholder font sizes in the main window for a clearer visual hierarchy.

### Installation and notes

Requires macOS 15 or later. The universal installer supports Apple silicon and Intel. Download `TSX-1.1.1-macOS-universal.dmg` and drag TSX into Applications, or use Check for Updates. The installer is Developer ID signed and Apple notarized; checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Source code is MIT licensed.

Copy text you want to keep before updating; translation text and screenshots are not saved as history. Automatic detection may misidentify isolated words; select the source language manually when needed. Automated tests do not establish validation on Intel, macOS 15 hardware, or the real upgrade path.

## 中文

- 重新整理设置窗口：左侧导航、可调整窗口大小、通透玻璃材质，以及更紧凑一致的控件与弹窗。
- 新增独立用量统计：总成本、总请求数、消耗 Tokens，支持日期和服务筛选、柱状图、热力图及分页请求记录。
- 成本统一按美元展示，微小金额保留提示与完整数值；支持更新模型参考定价。Apple 本地翻译显示免费，不虚构 Token 数量。
- 每个服务可独立配置用量记录、余额查询间隔与超时；更早的请求指标按天汇总，不保存翻译正文。
- 优化服务操作、日期选择、开关点击和滚动布局；减少自动余额查询引起的钥匙串提示，并避免重复请求已授予的系统权限。
- 更新入口集中到「关于」，新增近期更新。默认启动时检查新版本但不下载安装；开启自动更新后可下载、安装并重启，升级后展示一次更新内容。

### 安装与说明

需要 macOS 15 或更新版本；通用安装包支持 Apple silicon 和 Intel。下载 `TSX-1.1.0-macOS-universal.dmg`，打开后拖入 Applications，也可从旧版的「检查更新」升级。安装包使用 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证，校验值见 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

成本是参考估算，不替代服务商账单；缺少价格或用量的请求保留待计价状态。取词和截图仍遵循 macOS 授权；开发签名与正式签名切换时可能需要重新授权。孤立短词或截图标签可能识别为错误语言，可手动选择源语言。更新前请复制需要保留的文字，翻译正文和截图不保存为历史。

## English

- Redesigned Settings with sidebar navigation, a resizable window, translucent glass, and more compact, consistent controls and dialogs.
- Added a dedicated usage dashboard for total cost, requests, and consumed tokens, with date/service filters, bar charts, heatmaps, and paginated request records.
- Costs are shown in USD with readable small-value formatting and precise hover details. Refresh reference model prices in Settings. Apple translation is free and does not report token counts.
- Configure local usage recording, balance-query intervals, and timeouts per service. Older request metrics are aggregated by day without saving translation text.
- Improved service actions, date selection, switch hit areas, and scrolling. Automatic balance queries avoid prompting for Keychain access; already-granted system permissions are not requested again.
- Update controls now live in About, with recent release history. Launch checks are enabled without automatic downloading by default. Opt-in automatic updates download, install, and restart the app; release notes appear once after upgrading.

### Installation and notes

Requires macOS 15 or later. The universal installer supports Apple silicon and Intel. Download `TSX-1.1.0-macOS-universal.dmg` and drag TSX into Applications, or use Check for Updates in an older version. The installer is Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Costs are estimates, not provider invoices; requests without prices or usage remain unpriced. Accessibility and Screen Recording remain controlled by macOS, and switching between development and distribution signatures can require authorization again. Language detection may misidentify isolated words or screenshot labels; select the source language manually when needed. Copy text you want to keep before updating; translation text and screenshots are not saved as history.

# TSX 1.0.0


TSX（Translate X）是一款永久免费、MIT 开源的 Mac 原生翻译工具。

## 功能

- 快捷键翻译选中文字，通过浮窗查看结果。
- 截图识别与翻译，支持文字结果和原图对照。
- 双向编辑、自动互译、语言切换、复制与撤销。
- Apple 本地翻译，以及用户自行配置的第三方 API、兼容接口和本地模型。
- 菜单栏入口、自定义快捷键、中英文界面和多种外观。
- 检查更新及可选自动检查／下载，默认关闭后台更新选项。

## 下载与安装

下载附件 `TSX-1.0.0-macOS-universal.dmg`，打开后将 TSX 拖入 Applications。安装包已使用 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证。
`Source code` 归档是项目源码，不是安装包；校验摘要见 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

## 系统、权限与已知限制

- 需要 macOS 15 或更新版本；安装包同时包含 Apple silicon 和 Intel 架构。
- 取词和截图按需请求辅助功能／屏幕录制权限；macOS 可能在正式签名版首次使用时重新请求授权。
- Apple 翻译的部分语言需首次下载语言包；第三方服务由用户自行配置并承担可能产生的服务费用。
- 孤立短词、名称或很少的截图文字可能被自动识别为其他语言。若出现不相关的语言下载提示，请取消并手动选择正确源语言后重试。
- 原文、译文及截图不作为历史保存。退出或安装更新前，请复制需要保留的内容。
- 设置窗口偶发焦点回跳、非服务页面的滚动遮挡反馈尚未完成全面收尾。

源代码采用 MIT 许可证，第三方组件保留各自许可。官网：https://lumaxspace.com/zh/products/tsx/

TSX (Translate X) is a free, MIT-licensed translation app for Mac, with selected-text translation, screenshot OCR, bidirectional editing, Apple translation, optional user-configured services, and signed application updates.

Download `TSX-1.0.0-macOS-universal.dmg` and drag TSX into Applications. The source-code archives are not installers.

Requires macOS 15 or later. The universal app includes Apple silicon and Intel binaries. Accessibility and screen-recording access is requested when needed. Third-party service fees are separate from this free app.

Automatic language detection can misidentify isolated words, names, or short screenshot labels. Cancel an unrelated language download and select the correct source language to retry.

Copy text you want to retain before quitting or updating; text and screenshots are not saved as history. Existing reports of intermittent Settings focus changes and scrolling overlap outside service pages remain open.
